August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 146)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 26 across American network, Jim & Marian Jordan winning the raffle for 79 Wistful Vista in historic Fibber McGee and Molly for Johnson's Wax, Jack Moyles in Elliott Lewis' Cold War espionage thriller O'Hara, Jason Robards Sr. as Chandu the Magician in the Temple of the White Lama for White King Soap, Martha Rountree interviewing Senator Clyde Hoey on Meet the Press, and Police Headquarters (1932–1951):
